title: Renata Chałas
html: Professor Renata Chałas, MD, PhD is a Head of the Department of Oral Medicine and Dean of the Faculty of Medical Dentistry for the terms of 2020-2024 and 2024-2028 at the Medical University of Lublin, Poland. She is a specialist in general dentistry (I°), conservative dentistry (II°) and in periodontology. She has been an academic teacher affiliated with her Alma Mater since 1995. She also completed postgraduate studies at the Warsaw School of Economics - “Management of Health Care Organizations” - and postgraduate training at the Ministry of Science and Education and the University of Groningen “Masters of Didactics” in modern methods of education. Recipient of a Visegrad Funds Grant and the International Dean Leadership Development Program.
